instruction: Access the frequently asked questions section on the website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Ticketek homepage to the FAQ section. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains 'FAQ' pattern.
metadata.verification_notes: Using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. Pattern '(?i)faq' uses case-insensitive regex to match URLs containing 'faq', 'FAQ', 'Faq', 'faqs', 'FAQS', etc.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses case-insensitive regex pattern '(?i)faq' to match FAQ URLs
Pattern '(?i)faq' will match all common variations: 'faq', 'FAQ', 'Faq', 'faqs', 'FAQS', etc.
Getter 'active_tab_info' correctly extracts the active tab URL for verification
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly uses re.search() which supports embedded regex flags like (?i)
Evaluator provides complete coverage - checking if user navigated to FAQ section is exactly what the instruction requires
Pattern will work with common FAQ URL structures: '/faq', '/help/faq', '/faqs', '/faq-section', etc.
